name: Hardened Shells
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts fears his brother’s fuel will eat through their racer. He seeks tortoise shells to shield the tanks.

sections.title: Volatile Innovations
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, Wizzle Brassbolts and his brother race to outdo goblin engineers. Their custom rocket car runs on an experimental fuel mixture his brother has made. The mixture is so potent that Wizzle fears it will eat through the car’s usual chassis and tanks. He needs a container sturdy enough to hold it across the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Desert Armored Solutions
sections.body: Wizzle turns to the tortoises native to Thousand Needles. Their shells resist harsh elements and mechanical wear, so they may hold where refined metal fails. He hopes to gather the hardened shells and shape them into fuel tanks. They must contain the volatile mixture and keep the rocket car from blowing to pieces.

faq.q: Why does Wizzle need tortoise shells instead of metal?
faq.answer: Wizzle’s brother is brewing experimental rocket fuel that can dissolve metal. Wizzle hopes local tortoise shells will endure the chemical strain better than standard tanks.
Wizzle Brassbolts is a gnome engineer at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats. He and his brother build and fine-tune a rocket car to outrun their goblin competitors.

faq.q: Where can the tortoises be found?
faq.answer: Tortoises roam the Shimmering Flats salt pan, with dense gatherings near the old shipwreck in the northeast.

faq.q: Is this an Alliance or Horde quest?
faq.answer: The Mirage Raceway operates outside faction warfare and focuses on engineering competitions. Adventurers of either faction can help Wizzle.

faq.q: What happens once the shells are delivered?
aliases: what does wizzle do with shells
faq.answer: Once the shells arrive, Wizzle begins shaping them into reinforced fuel tanks. They are so durable that he expects to ruin a toolbox carving them.

faq.q: Why is fuel tank failure such a concern on the flats?
faq.answer: Rocket cars race at terrifying speeds across the salt. Wizzle fears his brother’s fuel could eat through the car’s chassis, so he wants reinforced tanks before that happens.

angles.text: Using organic armor plates to contain volatile compounds is an unorthodox choice. It shows the trial and error gnomish tinkerers rely on under pressure.
Brotherly ingenuity and reckless scientific ambition meet here. The work captures the gnomish drive to out-innovate goblin rivals despite every logistical hurdle.
